§bSeed Bags§r

Loot bags full of scanned CropsNH seeds, by game stage. Each has a Fortune twin with 10/10/10 seeds (normal bags give 1/1/1).

§bOre Seeds I§r (100/101): overworld ore crops + their ore blocks.
§bSeeds II Homestead§r (102/103), §bIII Industrial§r (104/105), §bIV Nether & Space§r (106/107, includes Rockbloom with the Greenhouse), §bV Endgame§r (108/109).
§bRare Heirloom§r (110/111): one rare seed; the Fortune one gives 20/20/20.

They are quest rewards throughout this book.

§cRebalanced§r: seed stats rise with the bag's stage (1/1/1 up to 6/6/6; Fortune bags double). Stage I-III seeds come unscanned. Rare Heirloom and Fortune Rare Heirloom are both 10/10/10.
